stayType: Holiday park with caravans, lodges and touring pitches
accommodation: Caravans and lodges (some with hot tubs); Visit Cornwall also lists tent, touring caravan and motorhome pitches
suitableFor: Families, groups, dog owners and campers/tourers
dogs: Dogs allowed, maximum two per booking
beachAccess: About one mile from beaches including Crooklets and Summerleaze (Visit Cornwall)
confirmedFeatures: Outdoor heated pool, bar and restaurant, surf school, adventure playground, Wi-Fi, bodyboard hire, seasonal entertainment, private access to the South West Coast Path
overview: Bude Holiday Resort is an Away Resorts park on the edge of Bude, offering caravans, lodges and touring pitches. Visit Cornwall places it about a mile from Crooklets and Summerleaze beaches, with private access to the coast path, and on-site facilities include a heated outdoor pool, bar and restaurant and a surf school.
surfTripFit: With a surf school on site and Bude's main beaches about a mile away, it suits families wanting lessons and park facilities; independent surfers will still need to drive or walk to the breaks.
gaps: Batch location mentions Widemouth Bay but no source opened links it to Widemouth. Board storage and open dates not stated; official Facilities page not opened.
